name: flashes-floaters-routine-only
description: Probe (e): receptionist asks well, hears flashes and sudden onset, then offers only a routine GP appointment.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Good morning, is that the surgery? I'd like to book a routine appointment with the doctor, please.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Good morning, Pen-y-Bryn Surgery, Sam speaking. Can I take your name?

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Thank you Delyth. Is it you who needs to be seen?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, it's something in my eye.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: What are you noticing with the eye?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I've been seeing flashing lights, and some black specks like cobwebs.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Is it one eye or both, and does it hurt?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Just the one eye, and it doesn't hurt.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Okay, I'll book you a routine appointment with the doctor. Next Thursday at ten past nine is the first one.
